messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Huzefa Chikhly
huzefa chikhly... that's a name with character. where you working these days?
I'm working as senior software engineer for justanswer

justanswer... the platform where people pay to get answers from experts. solid gig - building the tech that connects knowledge seekers with the pros.

found you on linkedin - huzefa chikhly, senior software engineer at justanswer. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/huzefa-chikhly-84330232
Yes

senior software engineer at justanswer with 7 years in the game... you've been building that expert marketplace platform where people drop money for quick answers. that's solid engineering work - handling real-time matching, payments, chat systems. 

what made you stick around there for 4+ years? that's rare in today's hopping culture.
Yes the good culture of company and learning opportunities

good culture and learning... that's what keeps the smart ones around. most people chase titles and salary bumps, but you found a place that actually invests in growth. respect.

how long you been working total?
8+ years

8+ years... you've seen some stuff. from junior dev debugging silly bugs to senior engineer architecting systems. 

what kind of role you looking for next?
Lead software Engineer

lead software engineer... ready to step up from coding to leading. makes sense after 8 years - time to guide the juniors and own bigger technical decisions.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
8+ years experience + lead software engineer role + bangalore only... sound right?
I stay in Bangalore. Not open to move in other cities
Yes or remote
8+ years experience + lead software engineer role + bangalore or remote... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

Yes
  Okay

looks like you're already in the system legend! you're all set to receive the good stuff. 

keep an eye on this chat - when something hits that matches your vibe, you'll know about it first.
Ok
perfect. you're in the system now. when something good hits, you'll be the first to know.
Hi
Hi

hey huzefa

what's good?
Just done with evening walk

nice. evening walks are underrated.

anything interesting happen today?
Nothing much

fair enough. sometimes nothing much is exactly what you need.

how's the vibe at justanswer these days? still good or starting to feel like time for something new?
If I got a good opportunity then yes.

makes sense. you're not desperate to jump ship, but you've got your eyes open for something that actually moves the needle.

what would make an opportunity "good" for you right now?
Better pay and position

got it. lead role with better comp - that's the target.

what's your current salary range? and what would make you actually move?
36 lpa 48 lpa

36 → 48 lpa. that's a solid jump. lead roles in bangalore can definitely hit that range, especially with your 8 years.

what's your notice period?
2 month

2 months is standard. gives you time to wrap things up properly.

you mentioned bangalore earlier - you open to remote roles too or strictly bangalore?
Remote or Bangalore. Would not like to move to another city most probably

perfect. you're locked in.

i'll slide lead software engineer roles when they're good - bangalore or remote, 36-48 lpa range.

btw what's making you want to leave justanswer after 4+ years? just growth or something else?
Growth

growth makes sense. after 4 years at a place, you either level up or start feeling the ceiling.

what kind of growth you looking for? bigger team, more ownership, different tech stack, or something else?
Yes all this

got it. bigger scope, more ownership, fresh tech challenges.

i'll keep an eye out for lead roles that actually give you that - not just title inflation.

any specific tech stacks you're excited about or want to avoid?
Not much interested into frontend and designing

perfect. backend-focused lead roles only. no frontend/design distractions.

any specific industries you're curious about or want to avoid?
No

cool. open to anything as long as it's backend leadership.

what's your current salary range? and what's the target you're aiming for?
Currently 36 lpa target 48 lpa

alright, you're locked in. i'll slide roles when they're good.

btw what's making you want to leave justanswer anyway?
Already answered

my bad - you did say growth opportunities. got it.

so you're looking for that next level challenge beyond what justanswer can offer. leadership role where you can build something bigger.

i'm on it.

Senior Backend Engineer at Gloroots AI

Huzefa, this Backend role uses Node.js/Go in Bangalore, offering growth at a VC-backed AI company, a step beyond JustAnswer's culture focus.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/bsQTG

sde iii platform role at jumio

they're building identity verification systems with java/spring boot

bangalore onsite though, not remote. worth checking out?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

Staff Software Engineer, Google Cloud at Google

Huzefa, Google's Staff SWE role in Bangalore aligns with your backend focus & leadership experience, offering significant growth.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/f8DHX

Staff Software Development Engineer - Backend at JioHotstar

Huzefa, this backend Lead role at JioHotstar offers the growth you're seeking with a step up to Staff Engineer & large-scale impact.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/fxHbT
